请求头 \| 必填 \| 值

\#\# Search 接口

\#\#\# 请求
curl https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\/v1\/tools\/search \\
  \-H \"Authorization\: Bearer \<DeepSeek API Key\>\" \\
  \-H \"Content\-Type\: application\/json\" \\
  \-d \'\{
    \"query\"\: \"DeepSeek V4 模型 发布\"\,
    \"count\"\: 5\,
    \"need\_content\"\: true
  \}\'
import requests

response \= requests\.post\(
    \"https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\/v1\/tools\/search\"\,
    headers\=\{
        \"Authorization\"\: \"Bearer \<DeepSeek API Key\>\"\,
    \}\,
    json\=\{
        \"query\"\: \"DeepSeek V4 模型 发布\"\,
        \"count\"\: 5\,
        \"need\_content\"\: True\,
    \}\,
\)
response\.raise\_for\_status\(\)

for result in response\.json\(\)\[\"results\"\]\:
    print\(result\[\"title\"\]\, result\[\"url\"\]\)
    print\(result\[\"summary\"\]\)

字段 \| 类型 \| 必填 \| 默认值 \| 说明 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-

count \| integer \| 否 \| 10 \| 返回条数，1～50。 
ori\_question \| string \| 否 \| \- \| 触发搜索的用户原始问题，1～128 个字符，有助于更好地理解搜索意图，传 null 视为未提供。 
localization \| string \| 否 \| \"\" \| 用于优先返回本地化搜索结果的 IP 地址。 
need\_content \| boolean \| 否 \| false \| 是否在 content 中返回网页正文，为 false 时 content 恒为空字符串。

\#\#\# 搜索语法

query 中的搜索语法会原样传递给搜索服务。下表中的示例将操作符与搜索词组合使用；你可以在一个 query 中组合多个操作符。

操作符 \| 示例 \| 说明 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
site\: \| DeepSeek site\:github\.com \| 将结果限制在指定站点，指定多个时用空格分隔并通过 OR 连接，例如 DeepSeek site\:github\.com OR site\:huggingface\.co。 
\-site\: \| DeepSeek \-site\:example\.com \| 排除指定站点，指定多个时用空格分隔。 
\- \| DeepSeek \-广告 \| 排除包含指定关键词的网页，指定多个时用空格分隔。 
\-\"\.\.\.\" \| DeepSeek \-\"release notes\" \| 排除包含指定短语的网页，短语内可以包含空格，指定多个时用空格分隔。 
\"\.\.\.\" \| DeepSeek \"精确短语\" \| 精确匹配指定短语，指定多个时用空格分隔。 
lang\: \| DeepSeek lang\:zh\,en \| 将结果限制在指定语言，多种语言用逗号分隔，例如 lang\:zh\,en。 
after\: \| DeepSeek after\:2025 或 DeepSeek after\:2025\-01\-01 \| 将结果限制在指定日期之后发布的网页。 
before\: \| DeepSeek before\:2026 或 DeepSeek before\:2026\-06\-01 \| 将结果限制在指定日期之前发布的网页。 

例如：
\{
  \"query\"\: \"DeepSeek 模型 site\:github\.com OR site\:huggingface\.co lang\:zh after\:2025\"\,
  \"count\"\: 10
\}

请求成功时返回 HTTP 200 与results 数组。搜索正常结束但没有匹配结果时，返回空数组。
\{

    \{
      \"rerank\_score\"\: 2\.4\,
      \"title\"\: \"DeepSeek V4 模型发布\"\,
      \"url\"\: \"https\:\/\/example\.com\/deepseek\-v4\"\,

      \"content\"\: \"DeepSeek V4 现已正式上线……\"\,
      \"site\_name\"\: \"Example News\"\,
      \"site\_icon\"\: \"https\:\/\/example\.com\/favicon\.ico\"\,

字段 \| 类型 \| 说明 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-

import requests

    \}\,

字段 \| 类型 \| 必填 \| 说明 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
url \| string \| 是 \| 要抓取的网页地址，长度不超过 8192，必须为含 host 的 HTTP\/HTTPS URL，且不能携带用户名或密码。

\{
  \"title\"\: \"Example article\"\,
  \"content\"\: \"\# Example article\\n\\nArticle content\.\"
\}

字段 \| 类型 \| 说明 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
title \| string \| 页面标题，缺失时为空字符串。 
content \| string \| 抓取后的 Markdown 正文。 

Fetch 的结果受目标站点的可用性和访问策略影响。

\#\# 错误

错误响应使用 OpenAI 兼容的错误格式，param 字段恒为 null。
\{
  \"error\"\: \{
    \"message\"\: \"\'count\' must be between 1 and 50\"\,
    \"type\"\: \"invalid\_request\_error\"\,
    \"param\"\: null\,
    \"code\"\: \"invalid\_request\_error\"
  \}
\}

HTTP 状态码 \| 说明 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
400 \| 请求头或请求体不合法，包括 JSON 格式错误或字段值无效。 
401 \| API Key 缺失或无效。 
402 \| 账号余额不足。 
403 \| Fetch 请求被安全策略拒绝。 
404 \| Fetch 未能获取可用的网页内容，例如 URL 不可用、被站点策略拦截、目标站点返回错误、内容类型不受支持或页面没有可提取的 Markdown 正文。 
408 \| 读取请求体超时。 
413 \| 请求体超过大小限制。 
429 \| 超过 Search 或 Fetch 的 QPS 限制。 
500 \| 服务器内部错误。 
504 \| 下游请求超时。 

Search 和 Fetch 都是只读请求。遇到 HTTP 408、429 或 5xx 错误时，请等待后重试。遇到 HTTP 402 时，请先充值再重试。对于其它 4xx 错误，如不修改请求，请勿重试。

\#\# 计费

Search 和 Fetch 按请求次数计费，不按 token 或返回结果条数计费：

API \| 计费单位 \| 价格 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
Search \| 每 1\,000 次成功请求 \| 5元 
Fetch \| 每 1\,000 次成功请求 \| 5元 

只有返回 HTTP 200 且产生结果的请求才会计费（Search 的results 必须非空，Fetch 必须返回网页正文）。请求失败、搜索无结果或超时不计费。count 只控制返回的结果条数，不影响单次请求的价格。

请注意，当前用户在 DeepSeek Harness\/Claude Code\/Codex 中使用 DeepSeek API 时，已经会通过 Server 端工具调用访问到 Search\/Fetch 接口，这部分 Search\/Fetch 接口调用目前未计费，并将于北京时间 2026 年 11 月 1 日 00\:00 起按次收取调用费用。

\#\# 限速

对每个账号，Search 和 Fetch 分别独立限速，互不占用额度：

API \| QPS 限制 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
Search \| 5 
Fetch \| 5 

QPS（每秒请求数）限制按账号粒度计算，与使用哪个 API Key 无关，并与模型并发限制相互独立。超过账号级 QPS 限制的请求会收到 HTTP 429 错误码。除了账号级限制，Fetch 还针对目标域名有 QPS 限制，超过该限制也会收到 HTTP 429 错误码。

The Search API and the Fetch API give agents and RAG applications access to live web content:

## Implementation internals — click to expand

This section explains the design decisions behind the tools; the observable behavior is fully covered in Use this package.

### Design philosophy

The package is built on one separation and one registration rule:

- The consumer owns the model-facing contract. Tool names, schemas, snake_case argument names, prompt sections, result bounds, formatting, and presentation all live here; provider selection stays entirely insidectx.web. The tools never call a provider's available() and never enumerate providers — their only execution path is ctx.web.search() / ctx.web.fetch().
- Enablement drives registration. A tool registers when enabled in config, independent of backend availability, so plugin load order, credential state, and HMR timing never enter the model-facing contract.

### Source map

File | Role 
---|---
src/index.tsPlugin entry: config schema, enablement, timeout budgets, tool registration 
src/search.tsThe web_search tool: argument validation, query fan-out, merge, formatting, presentation meta 
src/fetch.tsThe web_fetch tool: HTML→markdown conversion, output caps, formatting, presentation meta 

### Search flow

web_search validates the arguments (non-empty array, count bound, non-blank strings), collapses exact duplicates to first occurrence, then runs one to searchMaxQueries distinct searches concurrently through ctx.web. A failure aborts the batch via a fused signal; the call waits for every started search to settle before returning the first failure. Successful results merge round-robin by rank, deduplicate by URL, cap at searchMaxResults, and format into the model-facing text.

### Fetch flow

web_fetch removes active and hidden HTML before a shared turndown converter renders GFM tables and strikethrough. A lexical nesting guard and conversion failures produce a fixed omission marker instead of returning unsafe raw HTML, and a synchronous conversion cap bounds DOM work. The complete output — header, untrusted-content notice, rendered body, and truncation footer — is then bounded as a whole. Conversion is memoized per result and cap so registry render and presentation share one parse.

### Presentation

Each tool attaches structured metadata to its result (output.presentationMeta) — the faithful search sources, or the fetch summary (final URL, status code, effective truncation) — so the UI can render web result cards and replay reproduces them without reparsing the lossy render text. A UI without the web capability falls back to the raw tool result, which is the same text.

The new endpoints return structured web results or a page as Markdown. Each costs 5 yuan per 1,000 successful requests and is capped at 5 queries per second per account.

DeepSeek has added two standalone tools to its API platform: a Search endpoint that queries the web and returns structured results, and a Fetch endpoint that retrieves a single page and returns its content as Markdown. According to the company's Chinese-language API documentation, the tools are meant to give agent and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications access to live web content without a separate third-party search provider.

Both are raw JSON APIs that use the same Bearer authentication as the rest of the DeepSeek API. Search is served at api.deepseek.com/v1/tools/search and Fetch at api.deepseek.com/v1/tools/fetch.

A Search request takes a query of up to 128 characters and can return between 1 and 50 results, with 10 as the default. Developers can pass the user's original question to help the service read intent, supply an IP address to favor localized results, and ask for full page text. Queries accept operators including site: and -site: to include or exclude domains, quoted exact phrases, lang: to restrict languages, and after: and before: to bound publication dates. Each result carries a title, URL, a short snippet of roughly 100 to 200 characters for display, a longer summary of roughly 600 to 800 characters intended for models to read, an optional full-text field, a publication date, a rerank score from 0 to 3 and an authority rating from 0 to 4.

Fetch takes a single HTTP or HTTPS URL and returns the page title plus Markdown body. DeepSeek notes that results depend on the target site's availability and access policies, and that blocked or unextractable pages return an error.

Pricing is per request rather than per token or per result. Search and Fetch each cost 5 yuan per 1,000 successful requests. Only calls that return HTTP 200 with content are billed: a Search must return a non-empty result list and a Fetch must return page text. Failed requests, empty searches and timeouts are free, and the number of results requested does not change the price.

Searches triggered through the Web Search tool in Claude Code or the web_search feature in Codex will not incur Search fees for the first two weeks after the Search API launch. DeepSeek says standard pricing will apply afterwards and that it will announce the exact billing start date separately.

Rate limits are set per account, not per key. Search and Fetch are each limited to 5 queries per second, tracked independently of each other and of model concurrency limits. Fetch also applies per-domain limits, and exceeding either cap returns HTTP 429.

模型的内置知识受训练数据时间范围限制，无法保证版本号、价格和新闻等信息仍然有效。遇到这类问题时，Agent 需要通过外部能力搜索网络或读取网页。本章实现两个真实网络工具，并解释 DeepSeek Web Search 的调用方式。

一个容易产生的误解是，DeepSeek 没有搜索专用端点，找不到一个 POST /search 接口。官方 web-search-deepseek 的做法是：把搜索做成一次完整的模型调用，调用 Anthropic 兼容的 /messages 端点，并携带一个 web_search_20250305 服务器工具；服务器侧执行真正的搜索，把结构化结果作为内容块返回。官方文档第 11 行写明代价：一次搜索会产生完整模型轮次的延迟与 token 开销，比纯检索端点更重。

## 15.1 原理：搜索的三种形态

联网搜索常见的实现方式有三种，各有取舍：

| 形态 | 代表 | 取舍 |

| 专用搜索端点 | Exa、Perplexity | 快、便宜，但要额外服务商与密钥 |
| 模型内服务器工具 | DeepSeek web_search | 慢，一次模型轮次，但零新依赖、复用模型密钥 |
| 自己抓网页 | 通用爬虫 | 最灵活，但要处理反爬、HTML 解析 |

官方选了中间档：复用 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，不增加密钥，走 Anthropic 兼容基址 https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1。这个基址不是 chat-completions 的 https://api.deepseek.com，两个协议两个基址，官方文档第 15 行专门强调不复用 DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL。模型名是 deepseek-v4-flash，请求头带 anthropic-version: 2023-06-01，对应官方配置表的默认值。

## 15.3 解析：结构化来源与严格模式

响应的 content 是块列表，两种块与本章有关：

- text 块是模型基于搜索结果生成的回答正文。
